headline: Zcash to freeze $16 million in legacy Sprout privacy pool
summary: The Zcash network is preparing to freeze approximately 12,200 ZEC remaining in its original Sprout privacy pool. While users have been withdrawing funds recently, a significant portion of the assets remains in the legacy infrastructure.
why: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses zero-knowledge proofs to allow for anonymous transactions. The Sprout pool represents the network's earliest iteration of this technology, which is now being phased out in favor of newer, more secure protocols.

impacts.name: Zcash
impacts.why: The freezing of legacy assets may impact liquidity and user sentiment regarding the network's protocol migration.
